rows.en: I'm going to ask the Chief of Staff! To call off the test…
You idiot!! Don't do it!
Let go of me!!
Wait! Dan!! What's gotten into you, Dan?
Dan…

Don't forget, Dan! The Earth is a target. Didn't the Alien Pedan affair teach you that?

Some powerful invader that our current strength can't hold off is bound to appear! For that day…
We need a super weapon, is that it?
Of course we do!
The invaders will counter the super weapon by building an even more devastating weapon of destruction!!
Then we just build a weapon that's even more powerful than that, don't we!?

…………

That's… a sad marathon we'd keep running while coughing up blood…
Meanwhile… in the staff office deep within the base, final adjustments were being made for the super weapon's launch test.
There's no telling what interference may come from space against the R1 test. Stay on full alert!

Sir!

So the test is finally happening?
Yes… Please, rejoice with us.
If this test succeeds, we'll begin assembling R2 immediately!
Captain Kiriyama, don't be shocked! R2 has more than ten times the explosive power of R1!
What!? Then a planet like Earth would…
Probably two or three of them would be blown away in one shot.
The Earth is safe now! Absolutely…
So… where will the test take place?
We've chosen Planet Gyeron.
Planet Gyeron?

Yes… The seventh planet of the Shar constellation.

With that planet, there will be no effect on Earth at all! And there are no living things there.
Is it certain that there are no living things?

Yes, it's fine.

We spent 6 months studying candidates to choose the test site.
Letting the invaders of space know that we finally possess a super weapon is one of the purposes of this test as well.
If the test succeeds… Planet Gyeron will vanish from the universe.

Mm…

And for the R1 test, we'll set up our base's long-range radar to collect data!

It's already been decided that we'll invite Dr. Yushima, known as "the brain of the Earth", and install the "Yushima Diode" he developed.

Sir…

I've heard that the Yushima Diode dramatically improves the performance of any equipment.

So when will Dr. Yushima be arriving here?
He's already arrived in Japan from the Antarctic Research Center, and is on his way to this base by transport helicopter.
Dr. Yushima… the flight is going smoothly. Our arrival time at TDF Far East Base is right on schedule.
Well, thank you for your trouble. I'm sorry to put you through such tight security just for me.
Not at all, I believe protecting you is an even more important mission than fighting invaders, Doctor.

Thank you…

But… with transport security this tight, would any invader or alien really think of doing something to me?
Hee hee… Oh, Doctor, you're such a joker…

…!? An ambush, here of all places?

All units, intercept the enemy in combat formation!! Cover the transport helicopter!! Get the doctor safely to the base!

And request support from TDF Far East Base! Hurry!!
The enemy is after Dr. Yushima! No matter what, get the helicopter carrying the doctor to the base, understood?
Hawk 3… Roger!
Ah, if the Ultra Garrison has come… …………
…………… …then I can rest easy. Now, Ms. Kitakura, let's hurry to the base.
Yes, Doctor…
Well, you really saved me. Thanks to all of you, I made it here safely.

I'm just glad you're safe. Please take it easy today.

The Ultra Garrison will continue to guard you during your stay!
I'd have liked to say there was no need to worry… but after what happened earlier, I'd appreciate it.
Sir!!
And late that night… in the base's guest quarters, the TV in the room where Dr. Yushima slept displayed a strange image…
…Wake up, Dr. Yushima! Wake up.

We are the Alien Vira, conquerors of the entire universe.

We have chosen you as our minion for the invasion of Earth.

We captured the transport helicopter you were riding in with a Time Stop Ray, halted the flow of time, and implanted the mind of an Alien Vira in your head.

Your body is Dr. Yushima's, but your mind has become completely that of an Alien Vira!

From now on, you will faithfully obey our orders and help us conquer the Earth! Understood?
Yes…

Our orders…

Tomorrow, destroy the heart of the Terrestrial Defense Force base's radar! Understood?

A warning…

On Earth there is an alien who sides with the humans. His name is Dan Moroboshi. Beware of this man!
Understood…
Dr. Yushima… Did you sleep well last night?
Yes…

Then, to get right to it…

Setting up this long-range radar is a vital task, not only for the R1 test, but as the very foundation of our defense system.

We're counting on you…
Dan! Show Dr. Yushima to the Central Information Control Room.

Yes, sir!

Dr. Yushima… This way, please.
Dr. Yushima… This is the Central Information Control Room.
Dan. Set this Yushima Diode into the third circuit, would you?
Yes, understood.
Captain, the Central Information Control Room reports that installation of the Yushima Diode is complete.

Good. Once the long-range radar is working, we'll be able to detect four times as many enemies as before!

Begin the operational test at once!
Roger. Long-range radar, activate!!
What's going on!?

I don't know!? The radar seems to have stopped!

A powerful voltage surged back and appears to have damaged part of the power room!!
What!? Start repairs at once!!
Sir!!
Radar is the defense base's precious "eyes"!!
This is… a real disaster…

Captain! We've finished requesting stepped-up enemy searches from the Science Patrol, MAT and other related departments.

But they're nowhere near the scale of our defense base. And besides…

With the power room hit and the paddock's power down too, none of the Ultra Hawks can launch!

We're… completely defenseless.

Captain Kiriyama…

In my opinion… regrettably, it seems an alien spy has infiltrated this base…

Dan… When you took the diode from my hand, didn't you swap it for something else?
What did you say!?
Doctor… are you saying I'm a spy?
With respect, Doctor? What proof do you have to say such a thing?

Proof?

Isn't a serious accident like the radar breaking down proof enough?

Well… I won't go so far as to say there's a spy among you…

but there's no doubt that this was a deliberate act by someone trying to sabotage my work.

In any case… let's assume the worst and draw up countermeasures right away!

We'll borrow the doctor's wisdom too, and get through this crisis!

As of now… the Ultra Garrison is entering an emergency state!

Amagi and Anne, the two of you handle the restoration work!

The rest of us will guard the area around the base. If we're attacked now, it'll be a disaster. Let's go!!
